instruction: You are given a template with damping already defined: `/home/user/Desktop/complex_base.inp`. Complete the following from the command line: 1. First submit real modal analysis to generate `real_modal.eig`. 2. Write complex-modal input `/home/user/Desktop/complex.inp`: Please save the final input file as /home/user/Desktop/complex.inp. - Request 5 complex modes - Use `*Damping` values `alpha=10.0`, `beta=1e-5` - Constrain the fixed end 3. Submit the job and write a post-processing script to parse `complex.dat`: - Extract real part (Hz) and imaginary part (damping-related) of the first complex frequency - Compute modal damping ratio - Write to `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` in this format: `freq_hz, damping_ratio` 5. Do not use the CGX GUI. [Software] Run `ccx --version` or invoke the installed `ccx` binary from a terminal.
